The catalog defines its plan footnotes on this page: 5 = 'See approved General Education list for the AA/AS Degree', 6 = 'See program recommendations or requirements', 7 = 'See approved Foreign Language list for the AA Degree' — unspecified slots are modeled as choice slots with those definitions in choice_note; see advisor. UNR's BA requires four semesters of college foreign language (high school instruction does not automatically satisfy it). Per-course prerequisites are not listed in the schedule grid.
